summary: No installer-side threat indicators observed in blekit@1.0.0
details: Review of blekit@1.0.0 produced no a static rule matches and no traced install-time or import-time behaviors indicating credential access, network exfiltration, remote code fetch-and-execute, silent relay, backdoor, or self-propagation.
